title: SSRF through disallowed ports in onebox fetches
summary:
### Impact

`Onebox::Helpers.fetch_response` checked the resolved IP address but did not apply URL and port restrictions before making a request. On sites with allowlisted internal hosts, a user who can trigger a onebox preview could cause a onebox engine to request an otherwise disallowed port on one of those hosts, directly or through a redirect. Depending on the response and engine, data from that service may appear in the preview. The reported oEmbed case demonstrated metadata appearing in the response.

### Patches

The fix validates each URL and redirect destination in the shared onebox fetch helper before requesting it. Fixed release versions will be added after the fix and backports are released.

### Workarounds

Where possible, remove unnecessary internal hostnames from `allowed_internal_hosts` until a patched version is available. This may interrupt integrations that depend on those hosts.
